import json,pathlib,subprocess,struct,math
p=json.loads(pathlib.Path('.local/smart-shorts-audio/project-before.json').read_text());rows=[]
source='/Volumes/Portable Sandisk SSD/יומנו של יזם/Shadi/Yomano4.mp4'
for s in p['scenes']:
 if s['isMain']:continue
 clips=s['tracks']['main']['elements'];r=[]
 for e in clips:
  result=subprocess.run(['ffmpeg','-hide_banner','-loglevel','error','-ss',str(e['trimStart']/120000),'-i',source,'-t',str(min(2,e['duration']/120000)),'-map','0:a:0','-f','f32le','-ac','1','-ar','16000','pipe:1'],capture_output=True,check=True)

 rows.append({'id':s['id'],'title':s['name'],'clips':r})
 print(s['id'],'audio confirmed in',len(clips),'source intervals')
pathlib.Path('.local/smart-shorts-audio/source-audio-verification.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
